description: Who hit this bug: one row per affected end user (the app's identify() userId, else reporter email, else an anonymous IP-hash key) with firstSeen, lastSeen, occurrenceCount, platforms (web/ios/…), lastRelease and lastOccurrenceId. Pass a row's userKey to get_user_timeline to see everything that user experienced across bugs, or to get_repro_context via occurrenceId=lastOccurrenceId.

limit.description: Max users to return (newest last-seen first)
